RATIONALE: VP ranged mounted role prevents redundancy with Lancer/heavy shock cavalry and provides a continuous mobile-firearms niche.

VP repurposes the class as a mounted/ranged skirmisher, but the project already has tanks and mounted-skirmisher roles. Retaining a dedicated anti-armor gun preserves combined-arms counterplay. Final anti-armor bonus is tuned separately.
Attack helicopter is better represented as a highly mobile range-1 gunship than as melee cavalry. This also gives the Cavalry skirmisher branch a late upgrade endpoint.
Adopt VP-era defensive strength but not VP ranged attack. Organic ranged fire would double-count embarked aircraft; carrier remains a platform with base air cargo 2 and aircraft as its offensive arm.
